history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting now and starting to look at our first place. What’s the layout like?

Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. There’s a foyer before the open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, plus a small storage area and no long internal corridor. For a first home, the three bedrooms give you flexibility while keeping the shared living space open. It could be useful to see how the layout feels in person—would you like to arrange a viewing?
Thanks, that helps. Do you know roughly how big the bedrooms are? We’re trying to picture whether one could work as a small study later.

I don’t have the exact bedroom dimensions to give you a reliable estimate. The project material says all the bedrooms are designed to fit a queen-size bed, so one could be a usable extra room, but whether it works well as a study depends on the desk and storage you’d want. The show unit would help you judge the proportions in person, too.
That’s fair. Is the show unit open on weekends? We might be able to have a look together.

I don’t have confirmed weekend opening hours for the show unit. Since you might come together, would you like me to ask a salesperson to check whether it’s open on a weekend and contact you to arrange a visit if possible?
Yes, please ask them to check and get back to us if weekend visits are available. We’ll work out a time together.
Thanks — I’ll have a salesperson check whether weekend visits are available and get back to you. If they are, they can coordinate a suitable time with you.
